capex_override.ack_reason: Out-of-band by construction: the band is computed against the engine's last FILED capex value and TKO has never filed one in companyfacts (last_filed_value is null), so every value flags out-of-band, including this filing-proven figure. The value is not an estimate - it is the FY2025 capex printed in the filer's own FY2025 10-K cash-flow statement (see source), and no filed capex value exists in any period to anchor to.
capex_override.reason: DATA_GAP:capex - capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 of the last 3 in EDGAR companyfacts under every candidate tag the engine reads; the filer's own cash-flow statement reports this capex line for all three years. The engine applies this single FY2025 filing value to every missing period; the FY2023/FY2024 filing values in the same statement ($93.753M / $118.818M) are the same magnitude, capex is only ~2.7% of FY2025 revenue and ~10% of OCF, and the median year of the last-3 base is FY2024, where the single value overstates true capex by $8.135M (~$0.05/share on that year's share count) - immaterial to the verdict and conservative (it lowers OE). ttm.py prorates the same value across its legs, giving TTM capex of exactly the FY2025 figure vs a true filed-leg TTM of $122.766M (FY2025 $126.953M - H1 2025 $48.631M + H1 2026 $44.444M, both H1 legs from the Q2 2026 10-Q) - a $4.187M difference, ~0.3% of TTM OE.
capex_override.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25, accession 0001193125-26-071651), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Purchases of property, buildings and equipment and other assets': $(126,953) thousand for FY2025, with $(118,818) thousand for FY2024 and $(93,753) thousand for FY2023 in the same statement. The line is tagged in the filing's inline XBRL only under TKO's extension tag tko:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndOther, which EDGAR companyfacts does not carry (CIK 1973266 facts contain only us-gaap/dei/ecd namespaces and no standard capex tag), so the engine filed no capex value for any period. Corroborated in the Q2 2026 Form 10-Q (accession 0001193125-26-330592), same line: $(44,444) thousand for H1 2026 vs $(48,631) thousand for H1 2025.

moat_against: Media-rights pricing power is only proven at renewal; current deals are long but back-end weighted
Litigation overhang: fighter-pay/antitrust history and WWE shareholder litigation (settlement costs hit Q2 2026 SG&A)
IMG/On Location is lower-margin and event-cyclical (World Cup/Olympics years), diluting the core moat
Net debt $2.931B and a large noncontrolling-interest share of OpCo economics
Ticketing/hospitality demand is consumer-discretionary and cyclical
moat_for: UFC and WWE are the category-defining properties in MMA and sports entertainment - no substitute supplier at scale
Long-term contracted media rights with step-ups: UFC on Paramount (7 years from 2026), WWE premium live events on ESPN (5 years from 2026), Raw on Netflix
Asset-light model: venues are rented, capex is ~2.7% of revenue, and ticketing/hospitality/sponsorship carry premium pricing
Fans follow the promotion brand over individual fighters/talent, and promoter-favorable talent economics hold through cycles
moat_justification: UFC and WWE are irreplaceable category-defining sports IP with multi-year contracted media-rights step-ups already signed for 2026 onward (Paramount, ESPN, Netflix), an asset-light cost base, and brand-over-athlete fan loyalty - a strong moat. It is not a 9-10: rights pricing power is only re-proven at renewal, litigation (fighter pay, shareholder suits) is a recurring tax, the IMG/On Location segment is lower-margin and event-cyclical, and leverage plus the noncontrolling-interest structure sit ahead of Class A economics.
name: TKO Group Holdings, Inc.
one_liner: Elite sports-IP owner, moat 7/10 - but at $172.85 the price already pays for the new rights deals: weighted IRR 9.45% (Tier D), weighted IV@15% $91.05 vs $172.85; it clears 15% only at or below $91.05, and even the super-bull case (14.81% IRR) does not clear at today's price.
